{"reason": "All shown errors are truth=demand-forecast-error labeled unknown: 5 rows have forecast-bias with bias-amount 0.065-0.081 (below 0.1) and 3 rows have market-mismatch=#t with no other signals. I lower the bias threshold to 0.06 and add a demand-forecast-error branch for market-signal-mismatch when no supplier signal fires, recovering those claims.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.06))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((and (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
          (not (or (edi-increase? expedite-event)
                   (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
